### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

The page publishes no discount percentage or amount, no duration, and no funding, company-age, headcount or region criteria. Its 'What you'll need' list includes 'Program / VC' with the examples 'e.g., Y Combinator, Techstars, partner program.', which implies a partner affiliation is expected, but the page never states that partner affiliation is mandatory — hence partner_gate required-soft rather than required-hard. The redemption form itself is an on-page anchor (#redemptionForm) injected client-side and was not present in the fetched HTML, so the form's own eligibility questions could not be inspected. Quote re-confirmed verbatim on the page 2026-09-16. No discount percentage or credit amount is published anywhere on it.
